}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "Luckfox Lyra Zero W" is silkscreened on board bottom. {{See also|List of SBCs}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3506B @1.5GHz Tri-Core ARM (Cortex-A7), :1x ARM Cortex-M0 core *Storage: 256MB (SPI) NAND flash, TF card (max.256GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 512MB (DDR3L) RAM *Wi-Fi: [[AIC]] AIC8800 DC (2.4GHz 1T1R 802.11ax) :AX300; SDIO: Wi-Fi, UART/PCM: BT 5.2 BLE *USB: 1x USB 2.0 (Type-C) OTG, 1x USB 2.0 (Type-C) (Host) ports, :1× MX1.24 4-pin USB header *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power Source: 5V via USB (Type-C) port
